item.title: Web 1.0
item.description: Why call this website “Back to Web 1.0”? What is or was Web 1.0? What is the difference compared to Web 2.0 and 3.0? Why always add “dot zero” to the name? Are there other versions of the Web? Why is this description full of questions? Will they have an answer?
